releases.title: Install the project shell
releases.summary: This release creates the extension identity and documents the problem, repository structure, and test boundary.

releases.title: Add the first JSONB accessor
releases.summary: This release reads one top-level object field after PostgreSQL detoasts the complete JSONB value.

releases.title: Read selected JSONB data through TOAST slices
releases.summary: This release reads the root directory, object keys, and selected value through TOAST slices when the input is external and uncompressed.

releases.title: Add JSONB accessors and operators
releases.summary: This release adds key, index, and path accessors with JSONB and text results. It also adds matching operators.

releases.title: Add optional transparent access
releases.summary: This release can route built-in JSONB accessors through jsonb_slice in supported plan expressions when transparent mode is enabled.
